reuse.why: Fintegra and existing providers share linking and download helpers, reuse findOrCreateBank, and share local unlink cleanup with the existing unlink action.

duplication.why: The change removes repeated linking and transaction-download workflows and centralizes validation, holder lookup, and link cleanup.

placement.why: Request orchestration remains in accounts/app.ts, database link rules in accounts/link.ts, transaction downloads in accounts/sync.ts, and provider types in models.

scope.why: The edits cover the requested linking policies and Fintegra integration, with directly supporting refactoring and tests.

maintainability.why: Shared workflows simplify maintenance, although provider identity must still be coordinated between handler registration and provider adapters.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers use guardBankAccountLink and linkBankSyncAccount, and takeover cleanup shares clearAccountBankLink with unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: Repeated workflows are extracted into shared definitions rather than renamed or reshaped into additional copies.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared link guard gains the replaceExistingLink option and conditional handling for existing-account closed checks and replacement versus refusal; every provider remains routed through it.
